## Highlights

- Restore automatic Agent Skill upgrades from the exact package-owned bundle shipped through
  weightclass 0.26.0.
- Retain every 0.27.0 usability feature: same-process `wclass run --review`, stateless
  `wclass-advisory ask`, anonymous campaign stdin, grouped command families, verifier scaffolding,
  and Agent Skill onboarding generation 15.

## Compatibility and safety

The 0.27.0 installer omitted the exact 0.26.0 four-file Skill bundle from its historical
compatibility ledger. Consequently, an unmodified installed 0.26.0 Skill was safely rejected as
`skill_conflict` instead of being overwritten. This patch adds only those reviewed hashes. Modified,
extra-file, or symlinked Skill destinations still fail closed, and install/uninstall retain their
descriptor-bound exact-content controls.

The regression was reproduced against both local Codex and Claude 0.26.0 Skill installations.
After the fix, `skill status --target both` reported both exact upgrades as planned; the upgrade
completed and a readback reported both destinations `already_installed`. The focused Skill and
distribution suite passed, followed by the complete Python 3.10-3.14 and macOS CI matrix.

## Installation

```sh
uv tool install --upgrade "weightclass==0.27.1"
brew upgrade ictechgy/tap/weightclass
```
